headline: Recommended final passage of an amendment to Harbor Homes' 2006 grant agreement, allowing transitional and permanent housing for non-veterans and their families.
summary: The amendment changes Section 7 of a 2006 agreement between the city and Harbor Homes, Inc. The change would allow transitional and permanent housing for non-veterans and their families. Members voted 4-0 to recommend final passage.
decisions: Recommended final passage of R-26-080, amending Section 7 of the 2006 Harbor Homes grant agreement, by a 4-0 vote.

plain_text:
HUMAN AFFAIRS COMMITTEE 
 
  NOVEMBER 16, 2026 
 
A meeting of the Human Affairs Committee was held Monday, November 16, 2026 at 7:00 p.m. in the Aldermanic 
Chamber and duly noticed in two places, including the City’s website, in accordance with the requirements of RSA 91 -A:2 
II. 
 
Let’s start the meeting by taking a roll call attendance.   
 
The roll call was taken with 4 members of the Human Affairs Committee present:   
 
Chairman Thomas Lopez presided. 
 
Members of the Committee present: Alderman-at-Large Amber Morgan 
 Alderman Tim Sennott (via Zoom) 
 Alderman James Ravan 
 Alderman Thomas Lopez, Chair 
  
Members of the Committee absent: Alderwoman-at-Large Shoshanna Kelly 
 
Also in Attendance:  Alderman Paula Johnson  
  Matt Sullivan, Community Development Director   
  Liz Hannum, Economic Development Director 
             
 
ROLL CALL 
 
PUBLIC COMMENT 
  
COMMUNICATIONS – None 
 
UNFINISHED BUSINESS - None 
 
NEW BUSINESS – RESOLUTIONS  
 
R-26-080 
     Endorsers: Mayor Jim Donchess 
Alderman James Ravan 
Alderman Derek Thibeault 
Alderman-at-Large Michael B. O'Brien, Sr. 
Alderman Tim Sennott 
Alderman-at-Large Amber Morgan 
Alderman Thomas Lopez 
Alderman-at-Large Lori Wilshire 
AUTHORIZING THE CITY OF NASHUA TO AMEND SECTION 7 OF THE ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT 
INITIATIVE AND COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT BLOCK GRANT PROGRAM AGREEMENT BY AND 
BETWEEN HARBOR HOMES, INC. AND THE CITY OF NASHUA DATED JANUARY 3, 2006 TO ALLOW 
FOR TRANSITIONAL AND PERMANENT HOUSING FOR NON-VETERANS AND THEIR FAMILIES 
 
MOTION BY ALDERMAN MORGAN TO RECOMMEND FINAL PASSAGE 
 
A viva voce roll call was taken, which resulted as follows: 
 
Yea: Alderman Morgan, Alderman Sennott, Alderman Ravan, Alderman Lopez    4  
 
Nay:                 0 
 
MOTION CARRIED 
 
NEW BUSINESS – ORDINANCES - None 
 
TABLED IN COMMITTEE - None
Human Affairs – 11/16/2026                                                                                                         Page 2 
   
GENERAL DISCUSSION - None 
 
PUBLIC COMMENT - None 
 
 
REMARKS BY THE ALDERMEN - None  
 
 
ADJOURNMENT   
 
 
MOTION BY ALDERMAN SENNOTT TO ADJOURN 
 
A viva voce roll call was taken, which resulted as follows: 
 
Yea: Alderman Morgan, Alderman Sennott, Alderman Ravan, Alderman Lopez    4  
 
Nay:                 0 
 
MOTION CARRIED 
 
The meeting was declared adjourned at 7:19 p.m. 
 
        Alderwoman-at-Large Amber Morgan 
        Acting Committee Clerk
